items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Austin Derby would make that wow-wow effect, you know, see.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's the way. Would they move it at all?

One didn't make it wow-wow, you see. That's how they started making the wow-wow mute, you see. Austin Derby would make that wow-wow effect, you know, see. Joao was the first one that would start using that. What about? Buddy Petit, he was another one who used to use it.
What happened during the summertime back then? They had many jobs for the music?
